acceptance.expect: ^B-LEG-OFFLINE-OK b1_labels=[0-9]+ advisor=optional report_type=absent commentary=absent firms=3 models=5 b2_calls=\S+ b3_face=yes$

mutant.description: AR454-y-AC2 control, the B3 detector: the no-report fixture (fixtures_offline_noreport.json, the sections read removed so the Open report control reaches no report face) driven through B3 on its own (--phase b3 --ticket TCK-20261020-deadbeef). The composite AC2 run reaches b2 before b3 (surprise IRPT_ANLREQ-D2-W323-S1), so this control exercises the b3 detector directly; the composite AC2 stays a FAIL row.
mutant.expected: B3 standalone on the no-report fixture prints 'B3 report face=no' and 'B-LEG-BAD b3 face=no' with rc 1; on the positive fixture it prints face=yes with rc 0.
mutant.observed: standalone no-report (the B3 detector on its own): 'B3 report face=no headings=0 value=no', 'B-LEG-BAD b3 face=no', rc=1 (the detector fires). standalone positive (fixtures_offline.json): 'B3 report face=yes headings=1 value=yes', rc=0. Composite AC2 (the mutant as the cell names it): 'B-LEG-OFFLINE-BAD b2 ...analysis request was not sent...', rc=1, so the composite never printed b3: the composite-level mutant DID NOT FIRE at b3 (surprise IRPT_ANLREQ-D2-W323-S1 blocks the run at B2).
